name: takeover-dialog
description: Takeover dialogs are larger, flexible dialogs that contain other components to support complex workflows.

documentBlocks.content: Takeover dialogs are larger, flexible dialogs that contain other components to support complex workflows.

Title text overflow.

When the title is too long for the available horizontal space, it wraps to form another line.

Header content overflow.

Takeover dialogs can optionally include additional elements in the header custom content area. When horizontal space is limited, the header custom content will be displayed underneath the title.

Use similar language for dialog titles and actions.

Most dialog titles should communicate the primary action of the dialog. When possible, the button label should use the same language as the action mentioned in the title. For example, if the title is "Delete conversation," the primary action button label should be "Delete.

secondaryActionLabel.description: If undefined, this button does not appear.

cancelActionLabel.description: If undefined, this button does not appear.

slots.name: header-content
slots.description: Optional custom content in the header.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The dialog content: other components such as side navigation, a steplist or forms.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Large dialog surface. It is the root and carries the rounding, margin, background and, for the full-screen variant, fills the frame.

anatomy.name: header-content
anatomy.description: Optional custom content in the header. Hosts the header-content slot.

anatomy.name: button-group
anatomy.description: The button-group component that holds the dialog actions. Its buttons are slot fills; the action label options map to them.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Region under the header. It hosts the default slot (for example side navigation, a steplist or a form).

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Semi-transparent backdrop behind the dialog. A top-level part, not drawn inside the surface; it owns its colour and opacity.

anatomyReview.notes: Figma S2 Web takeover dialog: the Dialog variant root is the overlay (black at 44%) around the surface, and the full-screen variant has no overlay and no radius. React Spectrum S2 FullscreenDialog and Modal. Decisions (Garth, 2026-11-20): C3 top-level overlay part, and the takeover margin is margin on container pinned variant dialog; C4 button-group replaces the action parts; C5 body kept as the slot host. The slots array option is replaced by the slots declared on the component (slots memo step 5).
